theorem QOU.Archimedean.BalancedMomentConfluence.sum_c2_closed_form_of_one_le {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n - 1), ((↑k + 1) ^ 2 - 1) / 24 = (↑n - 1) * (↑n - 2) * (2 * ↑n + 3) / 144

theorem QOU.Archimedean.BalancedMomentConfluence.sum_c2_closed_form (m : ℕ) :
∑ k ∈ Finset.range m, ((↑k + 1) ^ 2 - 1) / 24 = ↑m * (↑m - 1) * (2 * ↑m + 5) / 144

theorem QOU.Archimedean.BalancedMomentConfluence.balancedNormalizer_one {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (n : ℕ) :
balancedNormalizer 1 n = ↑(n - 1).factorial

theorem QOU.Archimedean.BalancedMomentConfluence.qfact_one {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (m : ℕ) :
Mass.QDifferenceConfluentObstruction.qfact 1 m = ↑m.factorial

theorem QOU.Archimedean.BalancedMomentConfluence.qint_one {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (k : ℕ) :

theorem QOU.Archimedean.BalancedMomentConfluence.balancedNormalizer_succ {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (v : K) (hv : v ≠ 0) (k : ℕ) :
balancedNormalizer v (k + 1) = Mass.QDifferenceConfluentObstruction.qfact (v ^ 2)⁻¹ k * v ^ k.choose 2

theorem QOU.Archimedean.BalancedMomentConfluence.sq_balancedNormalizer {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (v : K) (hv : v ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
balancedNormalizer v n ^ 2 = Mass.QDifferenceConfluentObstruction.qfact (v ^ 2) (n - 1) * Mass.QDifferenceConfluentObstruction.qfact (v ^ 2)⁻¹ (n - 1)

theorem QOU.Archimedean.BalancedMomentConfluence.balancedNormalizer_inv {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (v : K) (hv : v ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
balancedNormalizer v⁻¹ n = balancedNormalizer v n

theorem QOU.Archimedean.BalancedMomentConfluence.pow_mul_qint_inv {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (q : K) (hq : q ≠ 0) (k : ℕ) :
